SELECT h.id, h.title, h.content, h.start_time AS startTime, h.deadline AS deadline, IFNULL( (SELECT total_score FROM homework_submit WHERE homework_id = h.id AND student_id = #{studentId}), 0 ) AS totalScore, c.course_name AS courseName, cl.clazz_name AS clazzName, IFNULL( (SELECT status FROM homework_submit WHERE homework_id = h.id AND student_id = #{studentId}), '未提交' ) AS status, (SELECT submit_time FROM homework_submit WHERE homework_id = h.id AND student_id = #{studentId}) AS submitTime FROM homework h LEFT JOIN course c ON h.course_id = c.id LEFT JOIN clazz cl ON h.clazz_id = cl.id WHERE h.clazz_id = (SELECT clazz_id FROM user WHERE id = #{studentId})
AND h.course_id = #{courseId}
AND ( #{status} = '未提交' AND ( SELECT id FROM homework_submit WHERE homework_id = h.id AND student_id = #{studentId} ) IS NULL OR #{status} != '未提交' AND ( SELECT status FROM homework_submit WHERE homework_id = h.id AND student_id = #{studentId} ) = #{status} )
ORDER BY h.create_time DESC

SELECT h.id AS homeworkId, h.title, h.content AS requirement, h.total_score AS fullScore, c.course_name AS subject, hs.status AS homeworkStatus FROM homework h LEFT JOIN course c ON h.course_id = c.id LEFT JOIN homework_submit hs ON h.id = hs.homework_id AND hs.student_id = #{studentId} WHERE h.id = #{homeworkId}

SELECT q.id AS questionId, hq.homework_id AS homeworkId, hq.score AS questionScore, q.title, q.type AS questionType, q.options, q.answer AS correctAnswer, hsd.student_answer AS studentAnswer, hsd.score AS questionScoreGot, hsd.question_submit_status FROM homework_question hq JOIN question q ON hq.question_id = q.id LEFT JOIN homework_submit_detail hsd ON hq.question_id = hsd.question_id AND hsd.submit_id = (SELECT id FROM homework_submit WHERE homework_id = #{homeworkId} AND student_id = #{studentId}) WHERE hq.homework_id = #{homeworkId} ORDER BY hq.sort ASC
